mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained quarterly GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals labor market strength.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) above 4.0% and 2.5% respectively signal aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% MoM in a late-cycle expansion context predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals an impending slowdown.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate decelerates below 1.0% MoM over the past month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods despite decelerating GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) by >5% and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by >0.2pp in the same month signal labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >5% AND UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in their respective directions.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerated monthly inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% growth rate predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it raises concerns about future rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL growth rate exceeds 2.5% in the past month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL accelerates.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (RSAFS) alongside elevated federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicates conflicting signals but persistent demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when RSAFS and FEDFUNDS meet the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Recovery in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month high signals improved supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in post-shock recovery regimes.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in post-shock recovery periods when INDPRO rises.
